OpsMill | Principal Software Engineer & Product Reliability Engineer | Europe/US | REMOTE | Full-time

OpsMill builds Infrahub, an open-source infra source of truth. Network and infra teams use it to manage their data and automate at scale.

Principal Software Engineer — own the architecture across our platform. Shape the graph database engine and backend, cut tech debt, push AI-first engineering. Need: 10+ years backend/platform, expert Python, track record scaling distributed systems.

Product Reliability Engineer — customers run us on-prem, so reliability is the product. You'll dig into Kubernetes escalations, find root causes, build tooling so issues don't come back. Need: 4-7 years SRE/production engineering, solid Kubernetes debugging, Python/Go/Rust. Remote. Apply:

Principal SWE: https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/opsmill/f7ef59f0-e2bb-43db-a450-c4e... Reliability Eng: https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/opsmill/b4af4790-46fd-430d-96bf-d45...

I'm Dimitris Saltaferis, Head of Engineering at OpsMill.
